correctness.rationale: Guo establishes at the threshold a real homological eigenvalue rho=±lambda, hence Δ_K(rho)=0. Such surgery yields an L-space knot (after mirroring if needed). The Alexander staircase admits no positive real roots: for t>1 each t^n+t^-n increases strictly with n, and the alternating sum pairs into positive differences; reciprocity excludes 0<t<1 and Δ(1)=1. Thus rho cannot be +lambda, forcing -lambda; reciprocity yields -1/lambda. The source normalizations, mirroring, endpoint and all positive exponents were inspected. No approximation of lambda is needed.
